scripts.watch:web: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const out='dist/web';const files=['index.html','style.css'];const copy=()=>{fs.mkdirSync(out,{recursive:true});for(const file of files)fs.copyFileSync(path.join('src/web',file),path.join(out,file));console.log('Copied web files');};copy();for(const file of files)fs.watchFile(path.join('src/web',file),{interval:250},copy);"
